start: Attendance (the register), gym that is online and has a gym code

steps.action: Open the check-in QR page from the register
user_sees: Title 'Check-in QR', line 'Members scan it with the MettleUp app and check themselves in', button 'Back to the register'

Card 'Scan to check in' with the poster: gym name, logo if any, the QR, the steps 'Open your phone camera', 'Scan this code', 'The MettleUp app checks you in', the line 'No app, or not on the gym list yet? Check in at the desk.' and the link app.mettleup.fit/c/<CODE>
Card 'How it works' with three steps and the gym code
must_not: Another gym's name, code or logo on the poster
The invite link (/j/) inside the check-in QR
A QR that is cut off

steps.action: Tap 'Print poster'
user_sees: The browser's print page with only the poster on the paper
must_not: The menu, the buttons or the 'How it works' card on the paper
An empty sheet
Two pages for one poster

start: Check-in QR page (another way to get the poster: a picture)

steps.action: Tap 'Download picture'
user_sees: A picture file named after 'checkin-poster' is saved and a short note says 'Poster saved as a picture.'
must_not: A picture without the QR or without the gym name
The note 'Poster saved' when no file was made
A picture with the logo of another gym

steps.action: Make the picture fail (for example the browser blocks the save)
user_sees: The note 'Could not make the picture. Try Print poster.'
must_not: No word at all
A broken, empty file

start: Set up your gym list (owner only), step 'Print the check-in poster'

steps.action: Tap the step 'Print the check-in poster' ('Members scan it at the desk to check themselves in.')
user_sees: The Check-in QR page
must_not: The invite poster page instead
An 'owner only' wall for the owner

steps.action: Tap 'Print poster', then go back to the list
user_sees: The step is ticked as done
must_not: The step still open after the poster was printed or saved
The step ticked for another gym or branch in the same browser

start: Check-in QR page of a gym that is not online (records kept in this browser only)

steps.action: Open the check-in QR page
user_sees: 'Put your gym online first' with 'Members check in from their own phone, so your gym must be online first. Go to Settings → Sign-in & data. Then come back here for the poster.' and the button 'Open Settings'
must_not: A poster with an empty or made-up code
Print or Download buttons

steps.action: Tap 'Open Settings'
user_sees: The Settings page
must_not: A dead button
A blank page

start: Check-in QR page, poster already printed once

steps.action: Open the page again on another day
user_sees: The same poster with the same code and link; both buttons still work
must_not: A new code or link, which would make the printed poster useless

steps.action: The owner changes the gym's logo or name in Settings; open the page again
user_sees: The poster shows the new name and logo; the QR and the code are unchanged
must_not: The old logo kept on the screen poster
The QR changed by a rename

steps.action: Tap 'Print poster' and cancel the browser's print page
user_sees: The page as before
must_not: A crash or a blank page after cancelling

start: Check-in QR page, signed in as owner

steps.action: Read everything on the poster and in the QR
user_sees: Only the gym's name, logo, gym code and the link app.mettleup.fit/c/<CODE>
must_not: A member's name or number
The gym's sign-in key or any secret inside the QR or the picture file

steps.action: Think of a stranger who photographs the poster and opens the link
user_sees: 'How it works' says the app matches a person to the Members list by mobile number, and sends anyone not on the list to the desk
must_not: A promise on this page that a scan alone, with no match to the list, records a visit
